analysis: The PR changes only test-only stub models. In ProviderLoopNativeMiMoLifetimeTests.swift line 41 (NativeFaultPeerModel) and FlintReasoningVisibilityTests.swift line 316 (VisibilityContainerModel), the LanguageModel.prepare signature moves from (windowSize: Int?) to (state: LMOutput.State?, prefill: PrefillParameters). This matches an upstream MLXLMCommon API change. Both stubs still return .tokens(input.text) and an empty cache. No production source, key handling, attestation, coordinator protocol, encryption, or prefix-cache storage code (T-041, TB-007) is touched. The rest of the lifetime test file is unchanged context. It exercises native MiMo owner retirement, drain/forced-drain behavior, and retained-fault handling using real owners, with the cache explicitly disabled (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0) and no credentials. These tests are opt-in via environment variables and add no new attack surface. Remaining question for other passes: the production code must already conform to the new prepare(state:prefill:) protocol signature. That conformance is outside the supplied evidence and is a build concern, not a security one. The unit 782da980914b29aa:0 had only metadata, and its patch was reviewed in :1. No security regression identified.
